title: Cogitave web app manifest
description: The drop-in slot contract. Every app/landing-page/campaign under apps/<slug>/ declares one app.manifest.json. The schema VALIDATES and INTERPRETS (mirrors the docs Schema-DSL approach): CI fails on a manifest that does not validate (blocking gate). Adding an app == adding a folder with a valid manifest + content; no shell code changes.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id. Immutable once live; the route may change, the id does not.

kind.description: app = multi-route experience; landing = single marketing page; campaign = time-boxed page (has `schedule`).

route.description: Mount path under the property origin, e.g. "/" or "/yuva-2". Must be unique across apps; CI checks for collisions.

property.description: Deploy property; must equal a properties[].name in self/domains.yaml (today: marketing-site).

mode.description: Per-app rendering mode on the 2026 hybrid spectrum. Prefer static; escalate only when needed.

revalidateSeconds.description: Incremental re-render window for static/island content.

root.description: Content-as-data root for this app, e.g. "content/". Documents validate against content/schemas/page.schema.json.

components.description: Shared component ids consumed from /components. The shell resolves these; an app does not ship its own copies.

structuredData.description: JSON-LD ids from seo/structured-data/ to embed.

events.description: Declared, privacy-safe event names (no PII). Fired only after consent for the relevant category.
